bounds: Initial bounded synthesis of current code, source manifests and recorded evidence; not a fresh Unity run or a complete object census.
Zone integration status applies only to listed primary packets; it does not certify complete art for every owner in that zone.
Authored frames, imported resources, native tests and ordinary Play acceptance are separate gates; frame counts are not coverage percentages.
Native tests and manifests do not prove all gameplay uses, arbitrary seeds, physical controller input, Steam Deck performance or packaged activation.
Historical detached two-seed census includes hidden and held owners; it is authoring evidence, not player-visible coverage. Its saved admission flags are historical.

status_terms.native_integrated_verified: Imported authored art and native runtime verification are recorded, within the referenced owner/state contracts.
status_terms.ordinary_partial: Specific ordinary-input actions/captures are accepted; the full object/state/use journey is not.
status_terms.ordinary_bounded_accepted: The referenced bounded service/route acceptance is recorded, not every possible encounter or product.
status_terms.ordinary_pending: New artwork has no accepted ordinary-input capture/use evidence.
status_terms.not_admitted: This real destination is not enabled in the current flat presentation.

global_delivery_gaps.detail: Current flat admission covers four exact graphs, not the six-site journey or whole world; leaving scope restores earlier art.
Normal bootstrap binds projection but does not enable flat mode. Editor-only launcher enables it; no accepted default fresh/load packaged route or persistent native setting.
No approved comprehensive native family fallback replaces the rough greybox categories across all regions.

Native tests, editor captures and bounded selector/editor timing are not physical Deck or mouse/controller acceptance. A current packaged native build and hardware performance/readability gate remain outstanding.
Six-site ordinary route, full item/reaction loops, presentation roundtrips and release evidence have not all passed together.

update_rule: Update status only from matching current code/source plus named native or ordinary-play evidence. Never promote a packet from old pre-art captures, a source contact or aggregate test/frame counts.

verified_foundations.detail: 40 corrected native RED cases followed by40 focused and90 disjoint regression passes; two cold reviews clear. No normal-launch or live-renderer change in this slice.

project_priority.deadline: No imposed daily or weekly deadline; meaningful verified progress determines cadence.
project_priority.decision_authority: User delegates choices beyond individual prompts; continue across sessions and prioritize delivered graphical coherence over unrelated feature growth.
